scope: isolated real HTTP provisional push adapter and signed callback protocol

checks.name: connector is explicitly configured per project
minimal device draft sends once with bearer, attempt identity and unchanged optional context
viewer writes and authorized alternate-project object access are rejected
forged and stale signatures do not update progress
signed callback commits once, changed duplicate rejects, push success waits for logs without fake asset
contradictory terminal push observation is retained without state regression
callback can arrive before HTTP acknowledgement without lock deadlock or regression
uncertain send needs explicit retry, duplicate new request is blocked, old callback cannot activate new attempt
cancellation persists and late callback cannot revive it
definitive internal HTTP rejection remains distinct from unknown outcome
restart retains collection/attempt/history and callback idempotency without resending
interrupted in-flight send restarts as unknown and can accept a later genuine signed observation

limitations: Loopback protocol double only; no actual internal service/Aliyun/device delivery.
This increment does not automatically correlate SDK uploads with collection attempts.
Deadline, concurrency and storage-failure bounds additionally covered by focused Go tests.
